dataPrivacy.title: Your Data & Privacy
dataPrivacy.subtitle: See what we store, how long we keep it, who we share with, and your controls
dataPrivacy.intro: See what MaurMaket stores, why we need it, how long we keep it, and the controls you have.
dataPrivacy.catAccountBody: Your name, username, email or phone, and sign-in details. Required to create and secure your account.
dataPrivacy.catOrdersBody: Items and prices, fulfillment choice, and payment, payout, and refund records. Required to run transactions and keep your receipts.
dataPrivacy.catMessagesBody: Conversations and offers linked to listings and orders. Required for coordination and dispute records.
dataPrivacy.catSafetyBody: Reports, blocks, verification outcomes, and sign-in or session records. Required to protect accounts and enforce policy.
dataPrivacy.catDiagnosticsBody: Crash and error data and basic device and app information. Used to keep the app stable and secure.
dataPrivacy.catPersonalizationBody: Your activity, used to suggest relevant listings. Optional — you can turn it off and reset it any time.
dataPrivacy.catPromotionsBody: Optional announcements about MaurMaket. Off by default and separate from account and order alerts.
dataPrivacy.retentionIntro: We keep data only while we need it for the purpose it was collected, or as the law requires. Some records are kept after account closure for legal, tax, or dispute reasons.
dataPrivacy.retAccountBody: While your account is active. Limited records are kept after closure for legal, tax, and fraud-prevention duties.
dataPrivacy.retOrdersBody: For the period required for receipts, tax, disputes, and fraud prevention.
dataPrivacy.retMessagesBody: While needed for order coordination and dispute evidence.
dataPrivacy.retDiagnosticsBody: For a short period, for reliability and security.
dataPrivacy.retentionCaveat: Exact dates can vary with legal requirements and open disputes, so we describe the retention trigger instead of promising a fixed deletion date.
dataPrivacy.providersIntro: We share data only with service providers that help us run MaurMaket, or when the law requires it. Providers process data for us — they never own your MaurMaket account or sign-in.
dataPrivacy.provPaymentsBody: To process MonCash and NatCash payments, payouts, and refunds.
dataPrivacy.provHostingBody: To store and serve app data securely.
dataPrivacy.provMessagingBody: To deliver push notifications and email.
dataPrivacy.provMapsBody: To show general areas and confirmed meetup locations.
dataPrivacy.consentBody: Personalization and promotional messages are optional and separate from the data we need to run your account, orders, payments, and safety. Turning an optional use off doesn't remove core features.
dataPrivacy.correctBody: Edit profile details directly. Identity or payment changes may need you to sign in again and be reviewed.
dataPrivacy.requestsBody: Ask for access, correction, export, or deletion of your data. Requests are verified before any change.
dataPrivacy.requestsNotice: Privacy requests are handled through Help & Support. A private request tracker is planned for the future Support portal.
dataPrivacy.summaryBody: See a readable summary of the data MaurMaket holds about you.
dataPrivacy.summaryFailed: Couldn't load your summary. Please try again.
dataPrivacy.copyBody: Copy your data as a machine-readable file you can save or share.
dataPrivacy.copyFailed: Couldn't prepare your export. Please try again.
dataPrivacy.exportNote: Exports contain your own data only. Copies you save outside MaurMaket are no longer under our control. You may be asked to sign in again before exporting.
dataPrivacy.footer: "Required" data is needed to run and protect your account and transactions. "Optional" data is your choice and never required to use MaurMaket.
permissions.title: Device permissions
permissions.subtitle: See what the app can access and open system settings
permissions.intro: Your phone controls these permissions. MaurMaket asks only when a feature needs it, and you can change any of them in your device settings.

permissions.openSettingsHint: Opens your phone's settings for MaurMaket

permissions.revokedTitle: If you turn a permission off
permissions.revokedBody: MaurMaket stops using that capability right away. Anything you had already entered is kept, and you can continue by hand or try again later.
